speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development given the significant increase in the amount of bets placed on lotteries and sports betting in the financial year ending March 2022 (a) whether, and if so, what concerns does the Ministry have; and (b) whether the Ministry assesses there to be a need for additional measures to be introduced, such as to curb gambling addiction or to highlight responsible gambling.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: MSF focuses on tackling problem gambling, as the negative impact goes beyond the individual gamblers and also affects the gamblers' families and loved ones.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Should an individual bet online excessively with Singapore Pools, family members can apply for a Family Exclusion Order to suspend the individual’s online betting account.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: At the end of the day, individuals should exercise personal responsibility and avoid betting beyond their means.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Help is available via the NCPG Helpline or Webchat.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We also encourage family and friends to look out for their loved ones and advise them not to bet excessively.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: First, for the avoidance of doubt, I certainly support all the measures that we have introduced over the years.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary mentioned that the attribution for the increase this year is due to pent-up demand because the previous year, we had COVID-19.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Therefore, by that, do we expect that in the coming year, this will normalise and it must necessarily see a reduction.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: My first supplementary question will be, what are the indicators we will look for before we feel that this is something that we need to introduce more measures for or find other measures?

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary also mentioned that we will look at Singapore Pools' online betting to see what the trends are.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: We know that there is a lot of betting which takes place not through Singapore Pools.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: So, my second question is, how do we monitor such trends?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: On the first question about what indicators do we look at, we must first understand that the numbers we are looking at in terms of what has been reported for FY2021/2022, is contrasted against a very low base in the previous FY.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: That previous FY, as I have explained, we have implemented quite number of measures, not just in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: But in Singapore alone, we have had our circuit breaker from April to June 2020 and also a whole slew of other postponements in terms of sporting activities.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: For instance, the Tokyo Olympics, for which is one of the favourites for sports betting, Copa America as well as the UEFA European Football Championship.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: These are some of the examples that really accounted for the low base in FY2020/2021.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: Having established this, what are the indicators that we look at?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: We can safely and quite surely rely on a few factors.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: For instance, we look at gambling participation rates over the years.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I think it has been stable throughout the past 10 years.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: The key, as I mentioned in my main reply earlier, is whether there is a problem of a rise in the incidence of pathological and problem gambling.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I do agree with the Member that on social issues such as these, we do want to err on the side of caution – which is why we have implemented quite a number of exclusions.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I will not repeat what I have already mentioned in my main reply.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I think it is also a matter of perspective – to some, it will be very onerous to be able to place a bet today.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: But I think for us as policy-makers, we want to strike a good balance, and I think we have done just that with our existing regime.
